description: This Java source file defines the CustomerAccountController class, which manages customer account-related web requests in an online shop application. It handles customer login, profile management, password change, address editing, and related operations for authenticated customers via Spring MVC annotations and methods.

classes.name: CustomerAccountController
classes.description: Controller class for managing customer account pages and actions such as login, profile editing, password changing, and address management within the shop application.

methods.name: displayLogon
methods.description: Handles GET requests for displaying the customer login page.

methods.name: displayCustomerAccount
methods.description: Handles GET requests to show the customer's account details page.

methods.name: displayCustomerChangePassword
methods.description: Displays the form for a logged-in customer to change their password.

methods.name: changePassword
methods.description: Processes POST request to update the customer's password after validation.

methods.name: saveCustomerAttributes
methods.description: Handles saving of customer attribute data submitted via AJAX, updating customer preferences or custom attributes.

methods.name: displayCustomerBillingAddress
methods.description: Displays the billing address of the logged-in customer.

methods.name: editAddress
methods.description: Displays the form for editing a customer's address.

methods.name: updateCustomerAddress
methods.description: Processes form submission to update a customer's address information.

methods.name: getCountries
methods.description: Provides a list of countries for address forms, based on current language context.
